_comment: Sanitizer / validator registry consumed by src/harness/sanitizer-registry.ts. Each entry under `sanitizers.<sink-class>` is matched against an expression by checkTaintedToSink-class detectors. The defaults shipped here preserve the prior inline VALIDATOR_PATTERNS behavior from src/harness/checks/tainted-sink.ts so the existing checkTaintedToPrivilegedSink answers don't change. Carved out of the .interlinked/* gitignore (see .gitignore) so it commits alongside guard-rules.json and large-files-baseline.json. Per-developer overrides go in .interlinked/sanitizers.local.json (gitignored).

url.name: url-host-allowlist-check
url.description: URL host extracted via `new URL(x).host` then compared against an allow-list (includes/indexOf/has/===) within ~3 lines

url.name: is-allowed-url
url.description: Identity-style allowlist function: isAllowedUrl(target) returns boolean

url.name: assert-allowed-domain
url.description: Identity-style allowlist assertion: assertAllowedDomain(target) throws on disallowed

url.name: check-redirect
url.description: Identity-style allowlist function: checkRedirect(target) gates redirects

identity.name: schema-parse
identity.description: Schema validators: zod / valibot / arktype Schema.parse(name)

identity.name: schema-safeparse
identity.description: Schema validators: zod / valibot / arktype Schema.safeParse(name)

identity.name: schema-validate
identity.description: Schema validators: joi / ajv / yup Schema.validate(name)

identity.name: typeof-guard
identity.description: typeof name === "string" / typeof name !== "..." runtime guard

identity.name: set-map-has
identity.description: allowList.has(name) — Set / Map .has(...) acting as allow-list
